meta.name: image-seo
meta.description: Image SEO audit — make a site's images discoverable in Google Images and stop them from dragging down Core Web Vitals. Audits alt text quality and coverage, descriptive file names, modern formats (WebP/AVIF), dimensions and compression, responsive srcset, lazy-loading, explicit width/height (CLS), image sitemaps, and ImageObject structured data. Use this skill whenever the user asks about image SEO, alt text, Google Images ranking, image optimization for search, image file size hurting page speed, WebP/AVIF, or image structured data. Trigger on: "image SEO", "alt text", "rank in Google Images", "optimize my images for search", "image alt tags", "WebP", "image compression SEO", "image sitemap", "ImageObject schema", or any image-discoverability / image-performance question. For overall page speed use /seo-analysis; for generating new images use the brand image skills.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提升网站图片在谷歌图片搜索中的排名与性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果网站图片在谷歌图片中排名低或拖慢页面速度
copy.tagline_en: Boost your site's image discoverability in Google Images and Core Web Vitals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your site images rank poorly in Google Images or hurt page speed

howto.what: 对指定网页或网站的图片做SEO体检，检查alt描述、文件名、格式、压缩、响应式适配、懒加载等是否利于Google图片搜索，并输出图片SEO评分、每张图的问题清单和修复建议。
howto.when: 当用户提到“image SEO”、“alt text”、“WebP”等关键词，或询问Google图片排名、图片搜索优化、图片影响网页速度等问题时触发。

say.text: 审计 example.com 的图片SEO表现
say.note: 会爬取该网站图片并给出评分和问题清单

say.text: 检查 /products 页面的alt文字和图片格式
say.note: 聚焦该页面逐张检查alt、格式、体积等

say.text: 这个页面的图片有没有拖慢速度？
say.note: 会关注CLS和懒加载，指出影响速度的图片

howto.what_en: Performs an image SEO audit on a given page or site: checks alt text, file names, format, compression, responsive srcset, lazy-loading, and CLS factors, then outputs an image SEO score, a per-image issue table, and prioritized fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions keywords like "image SEO", "alt text", "WebP", or asks about Google Images ranking, image search optimization, or images hurting page speed.

say_en.text: Audit the image SEO of example.com
say_en.note: Crawls images and returns a score and issue list.

say_en.text: Check alt text and image formats on /products
say_en.note: Focused on that page: alt, format, size per image.

say_en.text: Are images on this page slowing it down?
say_en.note: Checks CLS and lazy-loading to flag speed issues.
